entries.name: KoreanIM
entries.note: Pure-Rust 2-set Hangul composer: jamo to syllables, compound finals and vowels, final moves on a following vowel, backspace decomposes. No Hanja conversion, no ancient jamo, no 3-set layouts. Host tests only; needs a Midget check and wiring in kb_input.rs.
